problem: A particle $P$ moves along the $x$-axis and its velocity at time $t$ is given by $v(t)=3{t}^{2}-4t.$ What is the total displacement of the particle between $t=2$ and $t=4?$

activity_context.topic_title: Calculating the Displacement of a Particle Using Integration

feedback.worked_solution:
We find the total displacement by calculating the definite integral of the velocity.

Let $d$ be the total displacement between $t=1$ and $t=3.$ Then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}d & ={\int }_{1}^{3}(-4(t-1)^{3})\,\text{dt} \\  & =(-(t-1)^{4}){|}_{1}^{3} \\  & =[-{(3-1)}^{4}]-[-{(1-1)}^{4}] \\  & =-16-0 \\  & =-16.\end{aligned}
$$
